summary: German long technical report that serves as the appendix of a summary plus appendix pair (T05 is the summary). It carries 11 CP input sections plus the table-of-contents section, a large questionnaire and test chapter, the core EEG, task and channel ERP chapters, index, microstate, classifier and heart-rate chapters and a closing chapter of fixed treatment texts. Its only CP output slot is never rendered in pair mode, and CP output is rare in practice (a handful of reports a year).
